claims.text: All six arms recover identical full certificates on all three fixed fixtures.
Matched integrated parents isolate projective replay and the contiguous pivot directory while preserving exact full certificates.
L0 durations are diagnostics; isolated performance improvement and largest feasible scale are outside this panel.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Every execution corrupts the recovered scalar after timing and requires rejection. All-target unit tests also compare exhaustive positive and negative relation answers; no random-population claim.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Each fixed public target is constructed from a known scalar before solver invocation; solver sees only P,Q. Exact recovery and independent replay must pass every execution.

decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Exact counters and descriptive complete-cost ranges; no performance acceptance from L0 clocks.
decision_rule.interval: exact counts; diagnostic full observed range, no confidence interval
decision_rule.statistic: exact certificate equality and structural counters; descriptive stage median/min/max
decision_rule.text: All180cells must complete with full certificate equality and negative controls. L0 durations only guide optimization; they cannot complete the further10x performance goal.
decision_rule.threshold: All fixed cells complete with identical certificates; expected batching and reuse counters are consistent.

inadmissible: Calling retained table capacity total peak memory
Calling cached MITM tensor contraction or algebraic progress
Claiming largest feasible scale or rho/external advantage without matched measurements
invalidation_rules: Any full certificate mismatch, missing/duplicate cell, failed known scalar or negative replay, source/hash mismatch or deadline invalidates the panel.

literature.verified_by: Primary section read before implementation; reciprocal-candidate.md and curve-reciprocal/README.md document bounds.

literature.claim: The supplied paper Section3.5/Lemma13 defines inverse-hash listing; its exact first difference advances encodings by modular addition. Invocation-local validation preserves full parameter checks. Verifier base reconstruction changes, but both independent certificate replays remain charged.
literature.verified_by: Read implementation notes and validation records:37 standalone release tests, strict Clippy and format checks. No new novelty or performance claim.

literature.claim: Jacobian equality follows by cross multiplying x=X/Z^2 and y=Y/Z^3, with identity handled separately.
literature.verified_by: Primary coordinate definition reviewed during projective-replay implementation; independent affine-reference tests retained.

literature.claim: Contiguous traversal trades tree nodes for linear shifting on out-of-order pivot insertion; no latency improvement follows from the data structure alone.
literature.verified_by: Official Vec and slice partition_point contracts reviewed during pivot-directory implementation; independent tree-based reference checks exact dependency coefficients.

question: What complete cost and certificate behavior do projective replay and a contiguous pivot directory exhibit on all three fixed fixtures?

blinding.how: Unblinded analysis with fixed neutral machine labels; producer knows source mapping.

instance_sampling.rule: Three fixed complete-recovery software fixtures, covering 8/16-bit fields and 3/4 slots; no population or scale extrapolation.

seed_derivation.note: seed=111*(case+1), fixed across arms and rounds. Target scalar construction is solely a public known-answer fixture and excluded from solver inputs.

graphs: Per-arm complete CPU recovery diagnostic median and full observed range

power.note: Exact source-level counts and deterministic equality need no sampling power. Nine repeats characterize descriptive ranges only; no timed significance test or equivalence claim.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Unmeasured conservative allocation, not evidence. Round0 is fixed per-arm/case warmup/preflight. No timing data existed at freeze.

stopping_rules.rule: 6arms x3instances x(1warmup+9rounds)=180 rows:162 measured and18 warmups; no extra repeats after viewing results.
Any incorrect output, timeout or missing cell invalidates panel; preserve failures. Per-cell60s, whole job300s, one attempt, no automatic reruns.

factors.how: y/v differs only in compact pivot directory and software tests; z/y differs only in projective replay and software tests. u/v measures the accumulated implementation, not an individual change. Source snapshots and delta files bind the contrasts.
